name: arcextension
description: Curator client: reports tab activity snapshots and executes curator commands (§5, §6).
//key: Fixes the extension id independent of the load path (§6). Replace this PLACEHOLDER with the real public key of the signing keypair at packaging time; the value below is not a real key and must be regenerated per deployment.
//host_permissions: ONLY <all_urls> now. The two per-host patterns (https://<host>/* and wss://<host>/*) are REMOVED: with enrollment (§7, issue #35) the build is UNIVERSAL — there is no generator to stamp a concrete <host> at package time, and the service address is an operator setting entered per profile. <all_urls> IS requested — SECURITY-SENSITIVE, deliberate — and now carries TWO paths, not one: (1) execute_js runs curator-supplied JS in the arbitrary http/https tabs this instance manages (§6), and (2) the startpage's fetch to the service /api/* is a cross-origin request whose CORS host-permission is <all_urls> (slice C / §12). Both are gated (execute_js by the per-copy options checkbox default OFF + the server kill-switch + commands.js's http/https-only edge guard; /api by a Bearer carrying the RAW per-install instance secret — option A, the server hashes it on receipt — over a wss:// address the client refuses to downgrade, src/service-address.js). A future tightening of <all_urls> to a fixed host list must therefore account for BOTH the execute_js origins AND the /api fetch host, or the startpage goes offline fleet-wide.
//chrome_url_overrides: The newtab is the Vue 3 startpage built into startpage/ (offline-first quick links / search / jump / status bar, §10). All assets are local and the page runs under the extension_pages CSP `script-src 'self'` — the build uses base './' and precompiled SFCs (no runtime compiler), verified by the three §10 build gates.
//action: The toolbar popup is 'Rule from this tab' (§8, §10): one click to add a rule <origin>/* -> this instance with a server-side impact preview.
